title: Chibi Three Kingdoms
description: Recruit adorable chibi heroes of Wei, Shu, and Wu—chain dazzling ultimate combos in breezy side-scrolling brawls packed with loot.
controls: Tap hero portraits when rage fills to unleash signature ultimates and push through each campaign stage.
